measurement.latency: whole completed local call, unsplit per target request; includes local inference queue waiting
measurement.load: bounded closed-loop callers; threadpool admission waiting excluded; no HTTP SLO claim
measurement.warmth: model load excluded; first call can include cold operator initialization
measurement.tail_warning: small samples do not certify production tail latency
measurement.reference: first serial run; agreement is separate from correctness
measurement.boundary: measured top-two probability gap; score drift is gated separately

harness.limits: Synthetic rubric fixture, small local sample; no general accuracy or HTTP p99 claim. Workstation load is uncontrolled. Zero cache use, fp32/eager versus the pinned graph.
